newFeatures.title: Webhook support for third-party integrations
newFeatures.description: Receive real-time order and user events in your own systems via webhooks.

newFeatures.title: Export dashboard as PDF
newFeatures.description: Users can download any dashboard as a PDF report to share with stakeholders.

newFeatures.title: Add caching layer for API responses
newFeatures.description: Frequently requested API responses are now cached, so repeat requests return faster.

newFeatures.title: Add dark mode toggle to settings
newFeatures.description: Users can switch the app to a dark theme from Settings.

newFeatures.title: Faster search for large catalogs
newFeatures.description: Search results now load up to 50% faster on large catalogs.

newFeatures.title: Refactor authentication flow to use JWT tokens
newFeatures.description: Sign-in sessions now use signed tokens, so users stay signed in across devices more reliably.

newFeatures.title: Add better error messages for validation failures
newFeatures.description: Validation errors now name the field that failed and explain how to correct it.

newFeatures.title: Optimize image loading on product list
newFeatures.description: Product images on the list page load progressively, so the list appears sooner on slow connections.

bugFixes.title: Fix memory leak in parser
bugFixes.description: Parser streams are now closed after each chunk, so memory stays flat on long-running jobs.

bugFixes.title: Fix session timeout on Safari
bugFixes.description: Session refresh now works on Safari, so users are no longer signed out after a few minutes.

bugFixes.title: Email validation rejects valid international addresses
bugFixes.description: Email fields now accept valid international addresses.

bugFixes.title: Resolve crash when opening order history offline
bugFixes.description: Order history now opens offline and shows the last synced orders instead of crashing.

knownIssues.title: Webhook retries can deliver the same event twice
knownIssues.description: If a receiving endpoint times out, an event may be delivered twice. Workaround: de-duplicate events using the event id header.

knownIssues.title: Bulk CSV import times out above 50,000 rows
knownIssues.description: Imports larger than 50,000 rows may time out and must be restarted. Workaround: split the file into batches of up to 50,000 rows.
